results.references: - B. T. Polyak. [Gradient methods for minimizing functionals](https://www.mathnet.ru/php/getFT.phtml?jrnid=zvmmf&paperid=7813&what=fullt). 1963 (Russian original). Complexity: $O(\lceil (L/\mu)\log(\Delta/\varepsilon)\rceil)$ exact-gradient oracle calls for $0<\varepsilon<\Delta$, and zero calls when $\Delta\le\varepsilon$; fixed-step gradient descent gives $f(x_K)-f^*\le\varepsilon$ with a fixed budget.

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: The admissible class permits nonconvex objectives: global smoothness and the PL inequality are required, without convexity.

problem_class.label: pl
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization with an attained global minimum and global PL inequality 2μ(f(x)−f(xstar)) ≤ ‖∇f(x)‖². Parameters satisfy 0<μ≤L, Δ≥0, ε>0, and f(x0)−f(xstar)≤Δ.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Every query x returns the exact gradient of f at x for every call index and oracle seed. No function-value information or oracle error is supplied.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SmoothPL.lean: PLGradient.spec.Query, Reply, and admissible, requiring HasGradientAt f (oracle.answer k x seed) x.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is an arbitrary real Hilbert space, potentially infinite dimensional. The gradient is globally L-Lipschitz. E, L, and x0 are public; μ, Δ, and ε are hidden from the algorithm constructor, although they determine the fixed execution budget.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SmoothAndConvex.lean: Gradient.Public; LongTails/Setups/SmoothPL.lean: PLGradient.Params, spec.publicInput, and admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence.makeAlgorithm and budget.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The output is a point in E satisfying f(output)−f(xstar)≤ε for some global minimizer xstar. No gradient-norm or distance requirement is imposed.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The objective-gap requirement holds almost surely under the output probability law, which in Convergence uses the product of algorithm and oracle seed laws.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: Smooth unconstrained PL minimization with exact gradients, an initial objective-gap bound, and objective-gap accuracy is an established standard formulation, including its Hilbert-space version.
